svg.text: I've got the page structure. I'm creating index.html now with a
self-contained layout, then I'll copy the logo SVG into the same
directory so the hero and footer can reference it locally.
Built the one-page Beanline site as a single index.html with inline
CSS, semantic sections, and the requested warm editorial styling.
I also copied the logo next to it as logo.svg so the hero and footer
Beanline makes coffee, taken seriously. Warm service, careful brewing,
and a counter built for people who want the day to start with attention.
